question: Does a withdrawal always cost US$25?

response.message:
The current withdrawal charge is US$25 (or HK$200 / MOP200) for each cash withdrawal [1][2].

The withdrawal charge is waived for the automatic periodic withdrawal option [1].

The automatic periodic withdrawal option is only applicable if the policy has been in force for at least 10 years [2].

The brochure describes the US$25 figure as the "current" charge, meaning it is not a permanent fixed rate [1][2].

question: What happens if I stop paying premiums?

response.message:
You can skip premium payments as long as your Policy has accumulated sufficient Cash Value, and you will still enjoy protection without needing to reduce the sum insured [1][2].

No loan interest is charged while you skip payments [2].

However, monthly charges (such as the Cost of Insurance and other policy expenses) continue to be deducted from your Cash Value even while you are not paying premiums [3].

If your Cash Value is not sufficient to cover those ongoing monthly charges, the Policy will lapse with zero value [3].

The brochure does not state a fixed time limit after which you must resume payments; the key condition is simply that the Cash Value must remain adequate to cover the monthly charges [1][3].
